page.metaTitle: Earnings Release Monitoring — IR & 8-K Page Alerts | WebMonitor.fyi
page.metaDescription: Track earnings releases, 8-K filings, and IR page updates with checks as often as every 30 minutes. Plain-language email alerts for analysts, IR teams, and traders.
page.subtitle: Email alerts on IR-page earnings releases and 8-K filings for the tickers you track. Checks as often as every 30 minutes during earnings season, hourly or daily otherwise.
page.intro: During earnings season, refreshing IR pages and EDGAR all day doesn't scale. WebMonitor.fyi monitors a company's IR press release page and SEC EDGAR 8-K page in parallel — whichever publishes first triggers the alert, with checks as often as every 30 minutes on Pro and an AI-written summary of what changed in the email.

setup.title: List the tickers
setup.body: Pro includes 5 monitors, so pick the names where hearing early matters most — a concentrated position, the sector bellwether, or your closest peer.

setup.title: Add two monitors per ticker
setup.body: IR-page press releases and the EDGAR 8-K page — sometimes one publishes first, sometimes the other. Cross-coverage catches whichever lands first, at the cost of two monitor slots per ticker.

setup.title: Bump frequency during earnings windows
setup.body: Hourly or daily for most of the year. 30-minute checks during earnings windows. The dashboard lets you adjust each monitor's frequency.

setup.title: Webhook into Slack
setup.body: Add a Slack incoming webhook or a generic JSON webhook so the release lands in the team chat with a link as soon as the check fires.

examples: Equity research analysts watching their highest-priority names
IR teams monitoring peer earnings releases for competitive context
Hedge fund operators with concentrated positions tracking quarterly results
Portfolio managers running event-driven strategies around earnings
Journalists covering specific sectors on a tight publishing window
page.limits: IR-page monitoring catches whatever the IR team publishes publicly. Pre-market and after-hours-only releases sometimes go to wire services (PR Newswire, Business Wire) before the IR page; monitoring the wire-service company-page can supplement.

faq.q: How fast is the alert from publication?
faq.a: On a 30-minute interval (Pro), the alert arrives within about 30 minutes of the release posting. The company's wire-service page (PR Newswire, Business Wire) often publishes a few minutes before the IR page, so monitoring it can shave latency.

faq.q: Can I track guidance updates outside earnings season?
faq.a: Yes. Off-cycle 8-Ks frequently contain guidance revisions and material disclosures. The same monitors catch them year-round.

faq.q: Does this work for international companies?
faq.a: For ADRs filing with the SEC, yes. For purely foreign-listed companies, monitor their IR page directly — works the same way.
